info.title: Disputes Management
info.description: The Dispute Management APIs allows you to submit duplicate-listing disputes and check status for up to 100 items per request. For details on throttling, refer to the Walmart throttling documentation.

post.description:
Retrieve the duplicate dispute status for up to 100 items.

Provide `productId` and `productIdType` for each item in the request body. Typical HTTP outcomes: 200 (all items processed), 206 (partial content), 404 (no item found). Item status values may include: IN_REVIEW, IS_DUPLICATE, NOT_DUPLICATE, ERROR.

parameters.name: WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN
parameters.description: Access token obtained from the Token API. Required for authenticating requests.

parameters.name: WM_CONSUMER.CHANNEL.TYPE
parameters.description: Unique ID that represents the consumer request channel. Use the channel type provided during onboarding.

parameters.name: WM_QOS.CORRELATION_ID
parameters.description: Unique ID for each API call used for tracking and debugging. Use a randomly generated GUID.

parameters.name: WM_SVC.NAME
parameters.description: Name of the Walmart service being called.

code-samples.code:
curl -X 'POST' 
  'https://marketplace.walmartapis.com/v3/items/dispute/duplicates/status' \ 
  -H 'accept: application/json' \ 
  -H 'WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN: eyJraWQiOiIzZjVhYTFmNS1hYWE5LTQzM.....' \ 
  -H 'WM_QOS.CORRELATION_ID: b3261d2d-028a-4ef7-8602-633c23200af6' \ 
  -H 'WM_SVC.NAME: Walmart Service Name' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/xml' 
  -d '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<DisputeContestRequest>
<Issues>
<productId>string</productId>
<productIdType>string</productIdType>
</Issues>
</DisputeContestRequest>'
